'''Teen Queevello''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] fugitive who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Warden/Legends|Warden]] [[Vinzel Haylon]] tasked an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] with capturing Queevello.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TeenQueevello.jpg|200px|thumb|Randomly generated depiction of Teen Queevello]]
Teen Queevello was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]]. Due to the nature of many older [[W:c:swg:Quest|quests]] in ''Star Wars Galaxies'', the [[Species/Legends|species]], gender, and appearance of Queevello changed each time a player performed this quest. Therefore, it is impossible to verify the [[canon]]ical species of Queevello, which included a number of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] species, such as [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]] and [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]]. However, the quest dialogue given by Vinzel Haylon indicated that Queevello was a male.
